newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sandoz hopes for U.S. Novartis ruling.
newsitem.headline: Sandoz hopes for U.S. Novartis ruling.

text.p: Pharmaceutical maker Sandoz AG said Friday it was still hopeful of U.S. regulatory approval before the end of the year for its merger with Ciba-Geigy AG, becoming pharmaceutical giant Novartis AG.

A Sandoz statement quoted Chief Executive Daniel Vasella, who will be chief executive of Novartis, as saying he was still hopeful of U.S. Federal Trade Commission clearance before the end of the year.
Vasella has said in the past the merger might be pushed back into 1997 because of a slower than expected review by the FTC.
Vasella was quoted in a statement announcing German antitrust approval for Sandoz to complete its purchase of generic drug maker Azupharma from Gehe AG.
The statement did not elaborate on Vasella's views on U.S. approval for the Novartis merger.
The merger of Sandoz and Ciba to form the world's second-biggest pharmaceutical group was approved by each company's shareholders in April and by the European Commission in July.
Both Sandoz and Ciba said in late October they expected the FTC to rule in late fall on the Novartis deal.
